parsed.title: Inconsistent unit-lane budget reasoning
parsed.detail: The `mainReason` for `unit-lane` claims the ceiling was re-based from `2800/240` to `ceil(3026*1.10)=3329/ceil(245*1.10)=270`. However, the `mainEstimateMax` is set to `3329` (correct) but `mainLinesMax` is set to `270`. The math `ceil(245 * 1.10)` is `270`, but the previous value was `240`. If the new measured lines are `245`, the new ceiling is `270`. This is consistent, but the `mainReason` text says `2800/240` (the old values) while the math uses `3026` and `245`. The discrepancy is in the 'from' values vs the 'to' values in the prose.
